title: ARIA - An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Testing of Infotainment Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.04913v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automotive infotainment validation still relies on manual testing, slow, costly, and incompatible with agile releases and OTA updates. Scripted automation only partly helps: it couples test logic to implementation, yielding brittle, high-maintenance suites. Existing LLM-driven frameworks mostly target web/mobile apps, using single- or dual-agent setups that overload one or two models with perception, planning, action selection, and validation at once, prone to hallucinations and unproductive exploration loops given infotainment complexity. We present ARIA (Autonomous Real-time Infotainment Assessment), a multi-agent LLM framework that autonomously runs end-to-end tests on Android infotainment systems via visual interaction, using a closed-loop pipeline of four specialized agents per step plus a report stage. translated_title: ARIA——一种用于信息娱乐系统自主测试的智能体框架
translated_abstract: 汽车信息娱乐系统的验证仍然依赖人工测试，这种方式缓慢、成本高昂，且与敏捷发布和OTA（空中下载）更新不兼容。脚本化自动化只能起到部分作用：它将测试逻辑与具体实现耦合，导致测试套件脆弱且维护成本高。现有的LLM驱动框架大多针对Web/移动应用，采用单智能体或双智能体架构，让一两个模型同时承担感知、规划、动作选择和验证等任务，面对信息娱乐系统的复杂性时容易产生幻觉并陷入低效的探索循环。我们提出了ARIA（Autonomous Real-time Infotainment Assessment，自主实时信息娱乐系统评估），这是一个多智能体LLM框架，能够通过视觉交互在Android信息娱乐系统上自主运行端到端测试，采用由四个专门化智能体组成并附加报告阶段的闭环流水线。从单句场景描述（路径、动作、预期结果）出发，ARIA执行交互操作并生成报告以及可复现的……
tldr: ARIA是一个多智能体LLM框架，通过四个专门化智能体组成的闭环流水线，利用视觉交互在Android汽车信息娱乐系统上自主执行端到端测试，克服了人工测试的低效以及现有单/双智能体框架易产生幻觉和低效探索的问题。
en_tdlr: ARIA is a multi-agent LLM framework that autonomously performs end-to-end testing of Android automotive infotainment systems through visual interaction, using a closed-loop pipeline of four specialized agents to overcome the limitations of manual testing and existing single/dual-agent LLM frameworks that are prone to hallucinations and unproductive exploration.
